description: Move a project and its documents to the workspace identified by workspaceId from list_workspaces. Requires write and sharing access and can change inherited access to the project’s documents. Returns the updated project metadata and permissions. Use update_project for name, description, or instruction changes.

id.description: Project ID returned by list_projects, get_project, or create_project.

workspaceId.description: Personal account or organization ID returned by list_workspaces. Omit when optional to use your personal account.

name: move_project
title: Move Project
